name: grandorgue-mcp
description: GrandOrgue pipe organ simulator MCP server — MIDI bridge, organ control, sample set management, Bach repertoire

go_exe_path.title: GrandOrgue executable
go_exe_path.description: Full path to GrandOrgue.exe. Leave empty to auto-detect common install locations.

tools.name: go_status
tools.description: GrandOrgue process, MIDI, and organ status

tools.name: go_start
tools.description: Launch GrandOrgue, optionally loading an .organ file

tools.name: go_stop
tools.description: Terminate the GrandOrgue process

tools.name: go_midi_connect
tools.description: Open the MIDI bridge ports to GrandOrgue

tools.name: go_midi_disconnect
tools.description: Close the MIDI bridge

tools.name: go_list_midi_ports
tools.description: List system MIDI input/output ports

tools.name: go_play_note
tools.description: Play a single MIDI note through the organ

tools.name: go_play_chord
tools.description: Play a chord through the organ

tools.name: go_set_stop
tools.description: Toggle a drawstop via MIDI CC

tools.name: go_set_crescendo
tools.description: Set crescendo pedal position (0-127)

tools.name: go_set_enclosure
tools.description: Set swell enclosure level via MIDI CC

tools.name: go_combination
tools.description: Trigger a general piston via Program Change

tools.name: go_panic
tools.description: All-notes-off on all channels

tools.name: go_load_organ
tools.description: Load an organ by name or path (pywinauto-assisted)

tools.name: go_auto_load
tools.description: Reload the last-used organ

tools.name: go_unload_organ
tools.description: Unload the current organ from the registry

tools.name: go_list_organs
tools.description: List installed sample sets and free catalogs

tools.name: go_send_sysex
tools.description: Send raw SYSEX hex data

tools.name: go_marketplace_search
tools.description: Search the free sample set catalog

tools.name: go_marketplace_download
tools.description: Get the download URL for a sample set

tools.name: go_bach_catalog
tools.description: Browse the J.S. Bach organ works catalog by BWV

tools.name: go_play_midi_file
tools.description: Play a depot MIDI file via GO's built-in player (keystroke injection)

tools.name: go_play_midi_file_ui
tools.description: Play a depot MIDI file via pywinauto UI automation

tools.name: go_midi_playback_status
tools.description: Whether bridge MIDI playback is active

tools.name: go_stop_playback
tools.description: Stop MIDI playback and cut all notes

tools.name: midi_depot_list
tools.description: List MIDI files in the depot

tools.name: midi_depot_upload
tools.description: Upload a MIDI file (base64) to the depot

tools.name: midi_depot_download
tools.description: Download a depot MIDI file as base64

tools.name: midi_depot_delete
tools.description: Delete a depot MIDI file

tools.name: midi_depot_download_bach
tools.description: Fetch the full Bach MIDI bundle into the depot
